summary: Iter17 — Brevo Demo Funnel end-to-end testing (backend + frontend). All 20 backend test cases behave correctly (19 pass, 1 legitimate skip because a DRAFT-funnel lead has no unsub_token yet — which is by design in preview). Frontend renders the Funnel panel with Bozza badge, 12-metric dashboard, 4 steps, correct status select value 'draft'. Leads drawer correctly shows 'Nessun invio automatico per questo lead.' for a newly created lead while funnel is DRAFT. Draft-protection guard, cron auth, webhook auth, and unsubscribe HTML all behave as specified. No BREVO_API_KEY leakage detected. Preview graceful 400s treated as PASS per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4620 lines — recommend splitting into routers (funnel, brevo, cron, leads) per DRY/maintainability guideline (>700 lines).
brevo_unsubscribe route is registered on the raw @app.get('/api/brevo/unsubscribe') instead of the @api router — works, but inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
get_lead returns funnel enrollment inline; consider excluding _id explicitly with projection (currently uses {'_id': 0} — good). No leaks observed.
seed_data_creation: Two test leads (test_iter17_*, test_ui_*) created for lifecycle tests then cleaned up from db.leads/funnel_enrollments/brevo_events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_brevo_funnel.py. Uses cookie-auth via requests.Session; reads WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET/BREVO_WEBHOOK_TOKEN from backend/.env. Public POST /api/leads REQUIRES {"privacy": true} else returns 400. Funnel key is 'demo'. To activate funnel in real env, BREVO_API_KEY must be set and templates synced first (current guard returns 400 in preview by design). The unsub_token is only generated during enrollment (funnel active) — so unsubscribe-with-valid-token cannot be exercised in preview.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. All specified guards behave correctly: draft->active blocked in preview (400), sync/test return 400 without BREVO key, cron/webhook enforce bearer/token, unsubscribe returns HTML 404 for invalid token, DRAFT funnel skips enrollment on new leads and get_lead returns funnel:null.
